Between 2014 and 2020, the Dearness Allowance (DA) rate for Central Government employees was revised as follows:
- From July 1, 2015, the DA rate was increased from 113% to 119%.

From July 1, 2013, to June 30, 2021, the DA rates were:
- Increased from 80% to 90% effective from July 1, 2013.
- Increased from 28% to 31% effective from July 1, 2021.

From January 1, 2022, the DA rate was increased to 34% of Basic Pay.
reference: The DA rate has generally increased over the last decade with several key revisions: from 58% to 65% effective 1.1.2012; then to 72% on 1.7.2012; to 90% on 1.7.2013; to 119% on 1.7.2015; to 142% on 1.1.2018; to 31% on 1.7.2021; to 34% on 1.1.2022; and most recently to 50% on 1.1.2024. These revisions show a pattern of periodic increases approximately every 1-3 years.
